description:
Use this when you need to resolve or inspect topology against a script's lowered geometry. Pass the script as `code` (inline; works on a hosted server) or `file`. Selected by `mode` (default 'evaluate'):
- 'evaluate' — list the faces a Query matches ({ query }). Pass expect:'unique' to assert exactly-one.
- 'resolve' — resolve one ref to one face ({ ref }).
- 'lineage' — the creating/modifying history of a face ({ ref }; feature_id defaults to the last feature).
Query forms (faces only; edge/vertex kinds return query.unsupported-entity-type):
- a bare face label: 'top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right', 'front', 'back', or a hole/cutout slot like 'wall'.
- @kc[<feature-id>/face/<label>] — feature ids are the ones refs print, e.g. '@kc[box_1/face/top]', '@kc[hole_1/face/wall]'.
- @kcq[face(<filter>, ...)] — filters AND together: createdBy("box_1"), withLabel("top"), geometryType(PLANE|CYLINDER|CONE|SPHERE|TORUS|BSPLINE_SURFACE), closestTo([x,y,z]) or closestTo([x,y,z], k), containsPoint([x,y,z]); combine with union(a, b), intersection(a, b), subtraction(a, b). Example: '@kcq[face(geometryType(CYLINDER), closestTo([0,0,10]))]'.
Each matched face comes back with its canonical @kc ref, centroid, normal and area.

feature_id.description: Optional FeatureId; defaults to the last lowered shape (use "auto" for lineage).

file.description: Path to a .kcad.ts script file. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

query.description: mode:'evaluate' — Query: a bare face label ('top'), an @kc[<feature-id>/face/<label>] ref, an @kcq[face(...)] expression, or { ast }.

name: query
title: Query Geometry
